information: * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. You can refer "Schedule" tab to see the starting time of each event. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time, please bring a valid proof of identity (**NIC/Passport/Postal ID/Driving License**) If you still don't have any of the above mentioned identifications, bring a colour photograph of yourself certified by your school principal or a justice of peace. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the new competitor tutorial session at 08:30 AM on day 2 (check [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SriLankanNationals2024#competition-schedule)). * All participants are expected to volunteer for the event when they are not participating. The roles could be of a judge, runner, or a scrambler, depending upon the situation.
